newsitem.title: USA: Western pleased ADT-Republic deal dead.
newsitem.headline: Western pleased ADT-Republic deal dead.

text.p: Western Resources Inc, which opposed Republic Industries Inc's proposed acquisition of ADT Ltd, said it is pleased the transaction has been terminated.
Western holds a 24.3 percent stake in ADT and opposed the transaction.
"We never truly believed the Republic transaction was in the best interest of Western shareholders," said Western spokeswoman Michel Philipp.

Republic and ADT earlier announced the termination of the stock deal due to market uncertainty. Originally valued at $5 billion when it was announced in July, the value declined sharply due to volatility in Republic's share price.
Philipp declined to comment on Western's future strategy regarding Republic.
